process_doc: Models the extracted nursing-admission workflow from scheduled notification through documentation quality review and handoff of unresolved issues. Main-path task ownership follows the first bold actor; later bold actors are represented as counterparties in task names unless the extraction gives them a distinct task. Where a main-path step states that either actor may act, the first listed actor owns one task and the alternate actor remains explicit in the task name. Option entry and rejoin locations are modeling judgments where the extraction does not identify an exact point: changed and rush admissions are placed before preparation; simultaneous and after-hours admissions before nursing begins; medical, behavioral, and same-sex staffing exceptions during the initial nursing portion; participation during the first consumer interview; medication-history exception at reconciliation; and consent refusal at signing. Option C ends the routine process when disposition is outside OFC, and Option E ends the routine path when a separate legal or clinical barrier exists, because the extraction gives no continuation path for either condition.
